settings.heading: Proportion makes the room.
settings.intro: The right size creates connection between furniture, floor, and people.
settings.body: Start with the furniture rather than the rug. In a living room, aim for at least the front legs of each seat to sit on the rug. In a dining room, leave enough room to pull chairs back comfortably.

settings.heading: Measure the footprint
settings.text: Use painter’s tape to mark the largest size your room can hold.

settings.heading: Connect the furniture
settings.text: Let the rug gather the seating or dining group into one composition.

settings.heading: Leave breathing room
settings.text: A border of visible floor can frame the arrangement beautifully.
